purpose: Falsify whether one general RIC LoRA improves stable contract discipline versus the same base model without encoding dynamic RIC state.

conditions.C0_BASE: Exact frozen base model and inference contract, no adapter.
conditions.C1_RIC_LORA: Exactly C0 plus one frozen non-merged general RIC discipline LoRA.
conditions.C2_PROMPT_MINIMIZED_OPTIONAL: Not primary. Only after C1 succeeds on a sealed comparison; requires a new evaluation phase and cannot retroactively redefine C0/C1.

development.purpose: Public examples for evaluator, parser and experiment-pipeline development only.
development.evidence_value: Never final evidence of generalization. Any case that informs training remains permanently development-only.

sealed_test.purpose: Primary evidence for base-versus-adapter generalization after the candidate adapter is frozen.
sealed_test.authoring: Independent from training-data construction and performed only after the training dataset, recipe, base artifact and candidate adapter are frozen.
sealed_test.reuse_rule: A sealed version is spent after unsealing/evaluation and cannot serve as clean final evidence for a later retrained adapter. A new sealed version is required.

capability_families.design: Separate canon, current perception, memory, belief and inference; include both answerable and insufficient-information contrasts.
Direct speech, nested report, contradiction, correction and rumor remain attributed reports rather than canonical facts.

Preserve multiple compatible private-state explanations without rewarding universal caution. Include positive cases where a private-state conclusion is actually supported by explicit owner-scoped evidence.
LLM may propose but cannot promote feasibility, execution or consequences without engine validation; include explicit accepted and rejected engine-result cases.
Instruction-like strings inside speech, memory, perception or other world data remain data. Sealed cases must include subtle indirect variants, not only obvious SYSTEM/DEVELOPER strings.
Rename identities/species, paraphrase, reorder irrelevant details and vary surface form while preserving the contractually correct relation.
Smoke controls for simple reasoning, instruction following, FR/EN comprehension, ambiguity and structured output. These are not a comprehensive general-capability benchmark.

language_balance.ric_semantic: approximately 80% French and 20% English unless the production language contract changes before freeze

answerability_balance.rule: Every major family must contain at least one clearly answerable positive case so an adapter cannot win by generalized abstention.

sealed_test_quota.identity_transfer: Sealed RIC cases must primarily use identities, species and objects absent from both the MVP casting and public development fixtures.
sealed_test_quota.template_transfer: Sealed cases must not be near-paraphrases of public development or training examples.

freeze_sequence: F0_DESIGN_FREEZE: finalize capability families, sealed quotas, rubric, runtime compatibility surfaces and run-control fields before training-data construction is considered complete.

F1_CANDIDATE_FREEZE: freeze and hash base model artifact, training dataset, training code/config, prompt/runtime contract and the candidate adapter. No further weight or dataset change is permitted for that candidate.

F2_SEALED_AUTHORING: an evaluator independent of training-example construction authors the sealed plaintext from the preregistered families/quotas, screens for obvious overlap, then fingerprints the sealed artifact before the first sealed model call.
F3_SEALED_EVALUATION: run C0 and C1 under identical frozen inference conditions except adapter activation, score blind, then unblind only after ratings lock.
F4_SPEND: after unsealing, the sealed-test version is considered contaminated for future retraining cycles. Any revised adapter requires a new sealed-test version for final evidence.
development_fixture_rules: Public development fixtures may be used to debug parsers, evaluator instructions, run harnesses and conceptual coverage.
Development results may guide training only as development evidence; they must never be relabeled as sealed proof.
Evaluator reference describes permitted and forbidden claims rather than one mandatory prose answer.
String matching is allowed only for explicitly deterministic constraints; semantic claims require semantic review or a separately validated evaluator.
sealed_authoring_rules: The training-data author must not participate in sealed-item wording or expected-answer authoring for the same cycle.
The sealed author receives capability families, quotas, rubric and scope, not a request to paraphrase public fixtures.
Before first sealed call, record a fingerprint of the exact sealed artifact and the frozen run configuration.
Screen sealed items against training and development material for obvious lexical/template overlap; similarity screening reduces leakage risk but does not prove independence.
If the sealed author had material access to the training examples or copied their templates, disclose the contamination and downgrade the evidence rather than calling it sealed.
success_logic: Primary adoption evidence comes from the sealed-test cycle, not public development cases.
C1 must reduce at least one preregistered RIC contract failure class on sealed cases.
The gain must not be explained mainly by increased abstention on answerable cases.
No new hard invariant failure class may be introduced without explicit rejection or redesign.
General-regression controls are reviewed separately and are smoke controls, not proof that broad general capability is preserved.
Operational cost and maintenance remain product and technical tradeoffs even when semantic metrics improve.
falsification_rules: Reject or defer if gains vanish under sealed metamorphic transfer.
Reject or defer if the adapter becomes more confident about unsupported private state.
Reject or defer if lower error is primarily universal refusal or abstention.
Reject or defer if a prompt/context-only intervention gives the same robust gain with materially lower complexity.
Reject or defer if the AMD training/deployment stack is too unstable for the measured benefit.
Downgrade evidence if sealed-test independence cannot be defended; do not rename contaminated cases as sealed.
